description: Called by the frontend after receiving the FYERS widget finished callback (P7-T7). Updates the intent_ledger record to matched or submission_failed. Never advances position lifecycle — only intent status (REQ-ORDER-015/015e/015f).

responseFields.description: Always 'callback' when called via this endpoint
ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of callback receipt

notes: 404 when nonce is not found or intent was already updated. The response contains only intent_ledger fields — no position or notification fields (REQ-ORDER-015e).
